versions.changelog:
- Updated skill metadata to use the new "openclaw" format, specifying required binaries and the homepage.
- Removed "mediaio" metadata block in favor of the updated "openclaw" definition.
- No code or endpoint changes; all core functionality remains the same.

Initial release of the Media.io Image to Cartoon Generator skill.

- Converts photos and images into cartoon-style illustrations using Media.io's OpenAPI.
- Requires an image URL and Media.io API key for operation.
- Works asynchronously: submit images for processing, receive a task ID, and poll for results.
- Provides endpoints for checking available user credits, creating cartoon conversion tasks, and querying task results.
- Includes sample cURL requests and clear error handling guidance.
